local flag = true

local function TweenScale(model, targetScale, duration, steps)
	local startScale = model:GetScale()
	local function lerp(a, b, t)
		return a + (b - a) * t
	end

	for i = 0, steps do
		local alpha = i / steps
		-- Sine ease-in-out
		local eased = 0.5 - 0.5 * math.cos(math.pi * alpha)
		local scale = lerp(startScale, targetScale, eased)
		model:ScaleTo(scale)
		task.wait(duration / steps)
	end
	model:ScaleTo(targetScale)
end
